defect: an active-low reset release signal is consumed as an active-high reset
rationale: rst_ni correctly initializes the release pipeline low, but data_o resets when release_q[1] rises, exactly when the functional reset should be released.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the reset generator to its release pipeline and one state-holding consumer.

mutation.description: Changed the consumer to trigger and clear on the active-high release signal instead of the active-low reset.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Active-high reset taken from a release chain that rises after reset is released, so value_o is reset in normal operation.
